name: Street Kings
summary:
Step into the savage underground world of Street Kings, the most intense fighting VR game on Meta Quest! 💣 Brawl your way through dark alleys, gritty backstreets, and neon-lit arenas as you rise from a no-name fighter to the undisputed king of the streets 👑.

Use your fists 👊 or weaponize the environment around you. Smash enemies with baseball bats ⚾, crowbars 🔧, broken glass bottles 🍾, and more. Anything can become a weapon in your hands.
